title: Install commit-commands plugin at project scope and document the version-controlled plugin discipline
question: Does this PR enable the commit-commands@claude-plugins-official plugin at project scope via .claude/settings.json and add a CLAUDE.md that codifies the project-scope plugin and MCP discipline so future Claude Code sessions on this repo inherit the same toolset deterministically?
success_criteria: .claude/settings.json declares enabledPlugins with commit-commands@claude-plugins-official set to true so the plugin loads at project scope
CLAUDE.md is added at the repo root and documents the project-scope plugin and MCP policy plus the currently-enabled plugins table
CONTRIBUTING.md is updated so contributors are aware of the new commit workflow via slash command
no outcomes star outcome json or star report json files are touched by this PR so the outcome-gate's pair check is satisfied only by this new pair

capabilities: CLAUDE.md documents the project-scope plugin and MCP discipline and lists currently-enabled plugins
CONTRIBUTING.md mentions the new commit workflow so contributors discover it
